confluence_music.configuration.checkInte: The interval for checking whether biomes, events, and structures have changed
confluence_music.configuration.denyVanil: When this option is enabled, the vanilla music will no longer be played.
confluence_music.configuration.keepCreat: When this option is enabled and the player is in Creative mode, only Creative mode music will play; otherwise, ambient music will play.
confluence_music.configuration.lastSongF: Set it to 20, which means 1 second; set it to 0, which means stop immediately.
confluence_music.configuration.nextSongD: The total interval between the two songs is: lastSongFadeOutTime + nextSongDelay.
